page_title: VEN 2-3 JUV | Venezia v Juventus 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' John Yeboah (Venezia) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Michele Di Gregorio pulls off an easy save.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' A cross from John Yeboah (Venezia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Venezia get a corner.
86' Federico Gatti (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Francisco Conceicao.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mirko Maric (Venezia) replacing Mikael Egill Ellertsson.
85' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
82' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
81' Substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) on for Nicolas Gonzalez.
79' John Yeboah (Venezia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
77' Substitution. Marin Sverko is replaced by Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Issa Doumbia trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
76' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) replaces Randal Kolo Muani.
76' Andrea Cambiaso goes off the pitch and Weston McKennie (Juventus) comes on.
74' 5:6 – the corner kicks stats.
73' 2 - 3 Goal! Ionut Radu gets a hand on the penalty from Manuel Locatelli (Juventus), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
73' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

73' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andrea Colombo stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Juventus are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
71' The resulting set piece from Venezia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

71' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Issa Doumbia (Venezia) inside the box. He lets fly towards the top right corner, but Michele Di Gregorio was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. Venezia force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Daniel Fila is replaced by Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ridgeciano Haps walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kike Perez (Venezia).
67' Wasted opportunity! Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
67' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
65' John Yeboah (Venezia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Venezia.

63' Fali Cande (Venezia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Venezia have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
61' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.

60' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
58' John Yeboah (Venezia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' 2 - 2 Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
55' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

54' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
54' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
53' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
53' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' A dangerous towering header by Renato Veiga (Juventus) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
50' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
50' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
49' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
47' A pass finds the feet of Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
46' Igor Tudor makes a switch. Renato Veiga (Juventus) is coming on in place of Alberto Costa at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Juventus take a short corner kick.
45' The ball is cleared after Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Juventus have a corner.
44' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
43' That was close by John Yeboah (Venezia)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
41' Venezia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

41' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Venezia.
38' Some neat passing and movement from Juventus as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
36' John Yeboah (Venezia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
35' Igor Tudor isn't happy on the touchline after referee Andrea Colombo shows him a yellow card.
34' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
34' Venezia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

33' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Venezia are going to take it.
32' 46:54 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
31' 1 - 2 Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
28' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

25' 1 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:1. Ionut Radu was helpless.
22' Some great controlled play and passing from Juventus. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Alberto Costa (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
17' Venezia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Venezia will take a corner kick.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

15' A terrific piece of skill by Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
12' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
11' John Yeboah (Venezia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
10' Andrea Colombo interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
9' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) was too aggressive in his challenge. Venezia will take a free kick.
7' Celebrations are cut short for Juventus as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
7' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Juventus players aren’t happy.

5' Alberto Costa (Juventus) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top right corner. He makes it 1:1 with this magnificent strike.
2' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Ridgeciano Haps tees up Daniel Fila (Venezia) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Michele Di Gregorio.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
